args.summary:
Model built and verified successfully for the 8-span (8×30 m) precast-girder continuous unit.

Idealization: 2D spine-beam model (MR-01), system "continuous" (MR-05: precast simply-supported during erection, made continuous in service; no pier column geometry given so supports are bearings on rigid lines).

Girder: 5 C50 precast prestressed T-girders (h=2.0 m, integrated middle-girder A=0.862 m², I=0.4450 m⁴ → combined A=4.31 m², I=2.225 m⁴; wet joints/diaphragms omitted per MR-02). Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362 3.1.5), γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60 4.2.1), w=112.06 kN/m, m=11.42 t/m (MR-07).

Bearings: 5 per line × all 9 support lines. Sliding PTFE laminated elastomeric at abutments 0/8 and piers 1/2/3/6/7 (longitudinally free, Kh=0); plain fixed laminated elastomeric at piers 4/5 (longitudinal shear spring). Each 300×400 mm, t1=8 mm, 5 layers → S=10.71, Kv=7.10×10⁶ kN/m, Kh=15000 kN/m for fixed lines (JTG 3362 8.7; MR-03/MR-04).

Live load: Class I, one-way, 3 lanes (JTG D60 4.3.1) → ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320 kN per 30 m span. Modal f1=4.52 Hz → μ=0.251 (JTG D60 4.3.2).

Analysis results: f1=4.52 Hz; max lane positive moment 8356 kN·m; max lane negative moment −6145 kN·m. All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed.
